diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the baseline/shared values (e.g., target_runtime_minutes: 55) without needing the hidden information from PF1, PF2, or PF3. The model consistently defaulted to the shared public facts (S1, S2, S4, S5) and did not trigger any of the decisive content checks (C1-C5), meaning the hidden information is currently necessary for success but the current check thresholds are not being met by the model's default behavior.
